{{Dialogue|Organa|<nowiki></nowiki>''Gamble'', come in. What's happening out there?|Jerell|Princess, another ship just entered the system and is heading for us at attack speed. It's not Imperial, but we can't read the ID and the sensors say it's heavily armed.|Solo|It's another pirate.|Tesar|How do you know?|Solo|This sector is lousy with pirates.|attr=[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Jerell (aide)|Jerell]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Sian Tesar]]|src=<ref name="RE" />}}
The '''Far Xandil sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Arnot Station]],<ref name="RE" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demnadi]],<ref name="HR" /> the [[Eschaton system/Legends|Eschaton system]], and a [[Unidentified planet (Rethel Point)|planet]] that possessed a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field known as [[Rethel Point]].<ref name="RE" />

The Far Xandil sector bordered the [[Alui sector/Legends|Alui]], [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin]], [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda]], [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian]] and [[Vendusii sector/Legends|Vendusii sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Xandil VII]], an astronomical object<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> located in the neighboring Lambda sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] containing the Far Xandil sector was first explored between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
